_comment: Citation metadata only. The ADA Standards of Care reuse terms require ADA permission to
post the work on a third-party platform and forbid use for text or data mining or machine
learning without prior written permission, so no ADA prose is mirrored here and no ADA
passage text is ever sent to a model. Recommendation numbers, evidence grades and page
ranges are identifiers copied from the record; the `topic` strings are our own wording,
written to drive deterministic metadata matching in code, not to restate the guideline.

citation.licence: All rights reserved - ADA permission required for third-party posting, text and data mining, and machine learning
